plugins.name: instagram-ai-plugin
plugins.description: Drive your own Instagram account from the terminal with your browser session (no Graph API app, no Apify): sign in with cookies; read profiles, posts, comments and hashtags; publish photos, carousels and reels as approved dry runs; and run content, audit, competitor research and ads workflows on real account data.
